name: Panta curated Freightliner legacy MID/PID/SID/FMI reference
source_note: Curated factual reference derived from a user-supplied public document. This is not an OEM service manual. Verify exact vehicle, controller, protocol and current OEM documentation before diagnosis.

documents.title: Freightliner Legacy MID PID SID FMI Reference
documents.summary: Legacy Freightliner diagnostic identifiers include MID 128 engine, MID 130 automatic transmission, MID 136 ABS, MID 140 left instrument panel, MID 142 right instrument panel, MID 172 diagnostic system, MID 179 logging/black-box system, MID 181 satellite communications, MID 190 air conditioning, MID 219 radar/VORAD, MID 231 cellular communications and MID 234 right instrument panel #2. Common PID mappings in this reference include PID 84 road speed, 91 accelerator pedal position, 94 fuel delivery pressure, 95 fuel-filter differential pressure, 96 fuel level, 97 water-in-fuel indication, 98 engine oil level, 99 oil-filter differential pressure, 100 engine oil pressure, 101 crankcase pressure, 102 boost pressure, 103 turbo speed, 104 turbo oil pressure, 106 air-inlet pressure, 107 air-filter differential pressure, 108 barometric pressure, 109 coolant pressure, 110 coolant temperature, 111 coolant level, 114 battery current, 115 alternator current, 117 primary brake reservoir pressure, 118 secondary brake reservoir pressure, 157 injector-metering pressure, 158 switched battery voltage, 164 injection-control pressure, 167 alternator voltage, 168 battery voltage, 171 ambient air temperature, 173 exhaust-gas temperature, 174 fuel temperature, 175 engine oil temperature, 183 fuel rate, 186 PTO speed, 188 idle engine speed, 189 rated engine speed, 190 engine speed, 237 VIN, 247 total engine hours and 250 total fuel used. MID 128 legacy engine SIDs include SID 1-16 injector cylinders 1-16, SID 17 fuel shutoff valve, SID 18 fuel-control valve, SID 21 engine-position sensor, SID 22 timing sensor, SID 27 and 28 turbo actuator/control channels, SID 33 fan-clutch control, SID 34 exhaust-pressure sensor, SID 37 power relay, SID 39 starter relay, SID 41 ECM 8-volt supply, SID 42 injector-pressure regulator and SID 64 engine speed sensor #2. MID 136 ABS SIDs include wheel sensors SID 1-6 by axle/side and pressure modulator valves SID 7-12. Always interpret the full MID/PID/SID/FMI combination and vehicle context; a parameter identifier is not proof that the named component failed.

documents.title: How Panta should interpret legacy Freightliner codes
documents.summary: For legacy MID/PID/SID/FMI displays, identify the reporting module (MID), then the parameter or subsystem (PID/SID), then use the FMI to understand the reported failure mode. Do not diagnose from the PID or SID alone. Record whether the fault is active or stored, exact vehicle/year/engine/controller, symptoms, recent repairs and related faults. Older translated code tables can contain ambiguous wording, so use them as identification aids and verify repair procedures and specifications against appropriate OEM information.
